suites.title: Migration smoke: clean-channel roundtrip
suites.claim: all three public facades recover a clean-channel payload bit-exactly and Lite declares :posterior_anchor_ls
suites.origin: authored for this package (phase-1 migration gate)
suites.reader_summary: The OFDM+FEC, partial fast Fourier transform (Partial-FFT), and JUNA-Lite receivers recover every bit from their own clean transmissions, and JUNA-Lite reports that it uses decoder results for a second equalization pass.
suites.method: It uses alternating ones and zeros so that reversed signs or bit order cause a failure.

suites.title: Source file check
suites.claim: five selected Juna algorithm files and three LDPC helper programs match the values stored in this repository, so an unreviewed edit is visible
suites.origin: written for Juna; the first stored values were recorded during migration
suites.reader_summary: Five algorithm files and three helper programs are compared with values stored by Juna. If one changes without review, this test fails.
suites.method: For each selected file, the test calculates a SHA-256 value from its contents and compares it with the stored value.

suites.title: Migrated source layout and facade pruning
suites.claim: src/ carries exactly the Lite closure (common, frame_wide_ldpc, lite), exposes JunaLite, JunaOFDMFEC, and JunaPartialFFT as the canonical facades, and retains JunaStandard only as a compatibility alias while every foreign variant file and facade is absent
suites.reader_title: Files and receivers included in this package
suites.reader_summary: The required source files remain present; the OFDM+FEC, Partial-FFT, and JUNA-Lite receivers remain available, and the listed excluded receiver files and names remain absent.
suites.method: The test checks file presence, loading order, and available module names while confirming that removed receiver files and names remain absent.
suites.reader_origin: Adapted from the source layout test for this smaller package.

suites.title: Receiver selection and init defaults
suites.claim: the migrated runtime modes select distinct modems and init() resets to the benchmark geometry
suites.origin: adapted: scope narrowed to the three migrated facades
suites.reader_summary: The test checks receiver choices and valid settings, while initialization retains the selected receiver and synchronization settings and restores the paper frame dimensions.
suites.method: It constructs each receiver, checks accepted and rejected settings, changes the defaults, and checks the values after initialization.
suites.reader_origin: Adapted from the source test for the three receivers in this package.

suites.title: Public modulate/demodulate boundary
suites.claim: every migrated receiver crosses the m-sequence, 3x3 fc/fs, waveform-length, metric-polarity, payload-rate, and error contracts; supported boundaries recover clean payloads
suites.origin: adapted: scope narrowed to the three migrated facades
suites.reader_summary: Every receiver choice sends and recovers data through the same functions at several carrier frequencies and sample rates, reports the expected signal length and payload rate, and rejects invalid inputs.
suites.method: The test uses fixed bit patterns, exact and padded blocks, nine combinations of carrier frequency and sample rate, a short signal, and an invalid receiver setting.
suites.reader_origin: Adapted from the source test for the three receivers in this package.

suites.title: Modem interface and refinement capability contract
suites.claim: the descriptor catalog exactly covers the three migrated public facades; every path satisfies Modulations, executes its declared objective (:none, :pilot_band_ls, :posterior_anchor_ls), and decodes a noiseless loopback payload-exactly
suites.origin: adapted: scope narrowed to the three migrated facades
suites.reader_summary: The receiver list contains OFDM+FEC, Partial FFT, and Lite; each receiver provides the required operations, reports its stated refinement method, and recovers a clean payload bit for bit.
suites.method: The test runs the Partial FFT fit, checks that the JUNA-Lite function for a second equalization pass is present, and confirms that the three low-density parity-check helper programs are available. It can repeat recovery over several blocks when requested.
suites.reader_origin: Adapted from the source test for the three receivers in this package.

suites.title: Payload bits and block sizing
suites.claim: positive payload sizes exclude inner pilots (170 unknown of k=340), reject zero, and count 1280-sample blocks (N=1024 + CP 256)
suites.origin: copied during migration and now maintained by Juna
suites.reader_summary: Under the paper settings, one 1,280-sample block carries 170 payload bits; larger payloads use whole additional blocks, zero bits are rejected, and synchronization adds 4,096 samples.
suites.method: The expected values are fixed numbers from the paper rather than values recalculated from the receiver settings.
suites.reader_origin: Copied during migration and now maintained by Juna.

suites.title: OFDM tone layout and band partition
suites.claim: DC-nulled active tones split into comb pilots and data bands; bw times the fixed 24 kHz reference sets occupied width, fs sets the FFT occupancy fraction, and dc0 tunes the RF centre from 24 kHz without shifting baseband bins
suites.origin: copied during migration and now maintained by Juna
suites.reader_summary: The test checks which frequency tones carry pilots and data, how the tones divide into receiver bands, how many coded bits fit, and how bandwidth and centre frequency affect the occupied frequencies.
suites.method: It checks the exact tone counts, pilot pattern, divisions into 16 bands and four bands, data capacity, and changes caused by bandwidth and centre frequency.
suites.reader_origin: Copied during migration and now maintained by Juna.

suites.title: JUNA-lite soft-anchor refinement
suites.claim: posterior metrics become confidence-weighted soft data anchors, JUNA-lite refits an invalid seed into a finite valid candidate, and valid seeds are preserved
suites.origin: copied during migration and now maintained by Juna
suites.reader_summary: JUNA-Lite turns decoder results into weighted data values for a second equalization pass, improves an invalid first result, and retains an already valid result.
suites.method: The test checks the conversion and selection of decoder results before exercising both invalid and valid starting results.
suites.reader_origin: Copied during migration and now maintained by Juna.

suites.title: Baseline receivers: OFDM+FEC and partial FFT
suites.claim: the paper's OFDM+FEC and Partial FFT+FEC benchmark receivers are public modes pinned to their demodulate_methods columns, per-band combining survives the within-symbol channel one-tap cannot, lite never loses to its own seed, and both baselines roundtrip BPSK
suites.origin: copied during migration and now maintained by Juna
suites.reader_title: OFDM+FEC and partial fast Fourier transform receivers
suites.reader_summary: The two receiver choices use distinct processing paths and recover a clean payload; the partial transform also handles the selected channel that changes within one symbol and defeats the OFDM+FEC receiver.
suites.method: The test compares each public result with its direct receiver result, exercises the selected changing channel, and checks six fixed noisy packets. Across those packets, JUNA-Lite must have no more aggregate bit errors than its Partial FFT starting result.
suites.reader_origin: Copied during migration and now maintained by Juna.

suites.title: Decoder-feedback mechanism arms
suites.claim: the coupled receivers expose validated :real/:frozen/:genie/:graded feedback arms that share one code path, so frozen anchors no data decision, the oracle arms anchor transmitted symbols at unit weight and fail loudly without them, and graded corruption is seeded, bounded and on-constellation
suites.origin: copied during migration and now maintained by Juna
suites.reader_summary: The four settings use normal decoder output, pilots only, transmitted symbols, or transmitted symbols changed at a set rate; they share one processing path and differ where expected.
suites.method: The test checks accepted settings, required transmitted symbols, repeatable symbol changes, handling for each block, and the resulting refinement output.
suites.reader_origin: Copied during migration and now maintained by Juna.
